tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i mdos bskang rgyas pa'i ngag 'don re ma tī/ 'dzum zhal bsu ba'i mchod sprin bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ya māntā ka tsa dwe ya ma hā ka lī re ma tī sa pa ri wā rā ya/ 'dir dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i mdos bskang rgyas par bshad pa rdo rje seng ges mdzad pa'i gzhung gi ngag 'don nag 'gros su bkod na/ sogs phud bshams rnams shar ba'i gzhung de nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / yi dam chos srung gi bdag mdun gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs dang sbrel ba'am/ yang na gshin rje gshed sogs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas 'di'i gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga dang dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i gur khang me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i nang du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi la sogs pa drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du/ kṣa las be con kṣas mtshan pa las/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī dmag zor rgyal mo dre'u rta la zhon pa/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma'i dbus su khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa la me lce dang me stag du ma 'phro ba/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/

sku la khrag gi thig le/ zhag gis zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang re ldes stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi ske rags dang do shal sogs/ dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tsandan gyi be con nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon yungs dkar dang khrag gis gang ba'i nal thod thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sga yi snga shar nad kyi rkyal pa/ btsan gyi byang dmar/ sho rde'u dkar nag 'phyang ba/ phyi sha la mtshon gyi gru gu btags shing bdud kyi khram shing sked la gzer ba/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma dang spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba dbu steng du rma bya'i gdugs phub pa 'khor bdud phrug gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mig rtsa dmar zhing rab tu rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon na yungs dkar dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bsnams pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang shar mtsho mu le ding gi dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bhyoḥ chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma re ma tī/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ /bstan pa srung dang sgrub la phan gdags phyir/ /byang shar mtshams nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /bhyoḥrakmo bhyo bhyoḥrakmo thun bhyoḥrakmo kha la raka chen mo/ rakmo a bya ta bya thun bhyo ཿ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī de wi kā li kā li ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ a karṣa ya e hya ha ṭakki dzaḥhūm̐ bhyoḥ nag mo gdug can dregs pa can/ /kun tu khyab pa'i gzugs ston ma/ /nag mo gtso mo dre'u rta chibs/ /'dir byon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs/

/rakmo sogs kyis rjes su/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ tiṣṭhantu tri shya hoḥ padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ bhyoḥ za byed nag mo mche ba can/ dgod byed ha ha nag mo khyed/ gsod la dga' ba byed pa mo/ /bdag ni brda yi phyag bgyi'o/ /rakmo sogs kyi rjes su/ a ti pu ho pra ti dza ho/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣañtsa tu maṃ/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje gshed kyi dbur brgyan/ phra mo sbom po las byung ba'i/ /bdud rtsis bran pa'i dza gad 'di/ /dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rakmo sogs kyis rjes la/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /dwangs ma yi ni khrag chen po/ /dmag zor lha mo la 'bul gyi/ /bstan pa srung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rakmo sogs kyis rjes su/ ma hā rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga sbyar zhing / /'bru sna lnga sbyar gtor ma 'di/ /dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyi/ /bstan pa srung phyir༞ /rakmo sogs kyis rjes su/ oṃ shrī ye de wī ma hā ka li de wi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ bhundza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'i gtor sngags lan gsum mam lnga bdun la sogs pas phul/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba rnal 'byor pa chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod cing zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang rigs brgyud la sogs pa thams cad rgyas pa dang /

'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du 'du zhing / legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bu dang tsha bo rgyas pa dang / /'khor dang longs spyod rab 'phel zhing / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar gcod rnam mang po/ /thams cad gtan nas brlag pa dang / /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /de nas bzlas dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bhyoḥrakmo bhyoḥ bhyoḥrakmo thun bhyoḥ rakmo kha la raka chen mo/ rakmo a bya ta bya thun bhyoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ ci rigs bzlas pa'i rjes su phyi mchod nang mchod phrin bcol rnams gong bzhin byas la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag bskyed gang byas kyi lha bstod shlau ka gcig las/ 'dir phur pa byas pa'i dbang du btang ste/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ /mi zad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhe sdang thugs mchog yakṣa he ru ka/ /ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phan bde'i bstan pa skyong mdzad cing / /log 'dren 'dul mdzad bstan pa la/ /rab bzhugs thams cad bu bzhin du/ /skyong mdzad chos skyong rnams la bstod/ /bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje gzhon nu phyag 'tshal zhing / bdag bskyed gang byas kyi mtshan bsgyur/ tshig rol /phyogs skyong bcu yi tshogs la bstod/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyi spyan snga ru/ rdo rje 'chang dbang ma'i dbyangs rol tshar gnyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar khas blangs ma/

/dre'u rta la zhon rngam zhing shin tu brjid/ /srid pa'i rgyal mo chen mo khyod la bstod/ /kye kye/ ma gcig gnyen gyi re ma tī/ /khyod la dam rdzas mchod pa 'di phul bas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /'dod don ma lus sgrub mdzad khyod la bstod/ /nad dang gnod pa thams cad rab zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas mdzad cing / /skye 'gro dbang bsdus mngon spyod drag po yi/ /dgra bgegs rtsad nas tshar gcod ma la bstod/ /rnam dag sku lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /khyab bdag rang byung rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma he ru ka/ /dbyer med zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dur khrod gsang ba'i dbang drag dkyil 'khor du/ /thod pa dur khrod rin chen gzhal yas khang / /gnam lcags ur mo'i gzer chen ta la la/ /sprul pa'i lcang lo mang po'i kha bad can/ /bskal pa'i me ri smug nag 'tshub ma 'bar/ /mi ro thod phreng keng rus tshogs kyis brgyan/ /rakta'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs chi li li/ /rus chen tshogs kyi phung po khra la la/ /khrag dang zhag gi 'bab chu si li li/ /rdo rje zhing chen dri ngad thu lu lu/ /tsitta gsar rnying rgyan tog ye re re/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas/ bdag skyed gang byas kyi mtshan bzhugs/ /sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs mang po dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gros bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan myur du bstan du gsol/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i tshul gyis don mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /khro bo'i tshul gyis gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /'bar ba khro bo'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /skye med dmigs bral ngang las skur bzhengs pa/ /'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/

/khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i las mdzad pa/ /padma gsung gi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs kyi thugs/ /yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs༞ /dug lnga gtan bcom ye shes lnga sbyor ba'i/ /bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs༞ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus tshar gcod pa'i/ /phur bu phrin las lha tshogs༞ /dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa yi/ /'dus pa mdo yi lha tshogs༞ /thabs dang shes rab ye shes dges rol ba'i/ /ma mo sbod gtong lha tshogs༞ /bstan la gnod byed bgegs rnams tshar gcod pa'i/ /dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs༞ /nyes legs btang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs༞ /rdo rje gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin pho mo'i tshogs/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs la byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsi shing thams cad ye nas sman dang bcud/ /snang srid thams cad ye nas byang chub sems/ /stong gsum thams cad ye nas gzhal yas khang / /rgyud drug thams cad ye nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /sgra dbyangs thams cad ye nas sngags kyi sgra/ /ma sring srung ma ye nas bran dang g.yog /sbad cing sngags pa dam can mthu rtsal can/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /tshig rol sum brdung mthar gnyis rdeg 'phar chen rkang gling g.yab dar bcas/ bhyoḥ de wi ko ṭi'i dbyangs/ shlau ka gsum la tshar gsum/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na/ /nyi ma byang shar pha gi na/ /brag dang chu 'thab pha gi na/ mu le ding gi nang shed na/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur gyi nang / /me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i khrod/ /khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong / /mthing zhun sngon mo'i gur gyi nang / /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ /rngams brjid mgyogs pa'i dre'u'i steng / /kṣa las byung ba'i re ma tī/ /mthing nag ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ shur ma/ /be con thod pas phyag gnyis brel/

/dgra bgegs ma lus gsod par byed/ /snga sha g.yas la nad rkyal dang / /g.yon na phung byed sho rde 'phyang / /bdud kyi khram bam rgyab ru khur/ /phyi shar tshon gyi gru gu thogs/ /nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par yang / /bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung la brtson/ /dpal ldan lha mo spyan 'dren gyi/ /dmag zor lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /tshig rol chem brdung dang nag mo mthar chem brdung gsum len can 'beb bcas/ spyan 'dren gyi sngags nag mo gdug can sogs gong gtor bsngo bzhin/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swā bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā shuddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i phyi nang gi dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga yi me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ dung chen gyi gling bu sogs rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ bhyoḥ bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi gdangs/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying gi khrag /chu dang ma 'dres lbu ba 'khrigs/ /dmar chen rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil 'di/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ye de wi ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra ma hā rakta sa mu tra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha ye swāhā/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig dang ni/ /rna ba sna lce tsitta ste/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di/

/'dod khams༞ /bzhes nas༞ /tshe dang dpal༞ /rjes su mtshan sngags sbyar ba sogs 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre/ ma hā pañtsa ind+ra gu hya puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshil chen gyi/ /bdug spos sprin phung ltar 'khrigs pa'i/ /kun nas tshim byed mchod pa 'di/ /'dod khams༞ /bzhes nas༞ /tshe dang༞ /ma hā me dha gu hya dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi zhun chen la/ /dri chen ras kyi sdong bur bcas/ /rab 'bar gsal pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /'dod khams༞ /bzhes nas༞ /tshe dang༞ /ma hā ma du ra gu hya ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha khrag la/ /stong gsum dri yi tshogs kyis brgyan/ /dri zhim yid 'phrog mchod pa 'di/ /'dod khams༞ /bzhes nas༞ /tshe dang༞ /ma hā ba sa dhu dhi raṃ gu hya ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ 'bru sna lnga sogs gtor ma la/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs kyis brgyan/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /ma hā maṃ sa rakta bhundza tha pi pa tha āḥhūm̐/ bcom dung bcom rol sogs dril bu dam tshig pa bzhin de yi dbyangs bcas/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi rus lpags kyi/ /rkang gling rnga sgra la sogs pa'i/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa 'di/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /ma hā shapta pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ sman rag gtor gsum gtor bsngo phyi nang gi mchod pa/ 'phrin bcol rnams gong ltar gtor bsngo bzhin/ chos dbyings spros bral ngang las gdul bya'i ngor/ /me rlung dbus su 'jigs rung khro mo'i sku/ /'phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i dpal ldan ma/ /dmag zor rgyal mo bdag la brtse bas dgongs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig mnyes byed pa'i/ /mchod rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul bsam mi khyab/ /sa dang bar snang yongs su gang ba 'di/

/gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /thog med dus nas rang sems 'khrul snang gi /rtog pas bslad pa'i las ngan ci bsags dang / /skye ba 'dir yang bcas rang gis bsdus pa'i/ /nyes ltung dri mas phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /mthu ldan khyod kyis bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'gro rnams skyong ba dang / /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /byang chub bar du mgon dang sdong grogs mdzod/ /pha rol ngan pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad zor la sogs/ /mi dang mi min gnod pa ma lus pa/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog tu gsol/ /chos kun sgrib med gzigs pa dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku/ /de phyir mkhyen brtse nus pa kun gyi gter/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /gang sku nam mkha'i mdangs ldan me 'od 'phro/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con thod pas sbrel/ /drag mo'i gzugs can 'jigs pa'i rgyan cha 'chang / /bdud dpung zil gnon lha mo'i sku la bstod/ /ha ha'i bzhad sgras sa gzhi kun g.yo zhing / /hūm̐ phaṭa drag po'i sgra yis log 'dren 'dul/ /thos pa tsam gyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i gsung la bdag bstod do/ /gdod nas chos kun ye stong ye bral ba'i/ /brjod bral ngang las skad cig ma g.yos kyang / /bstan pa bsrung phyir drag gtum tshul ston pa'i/ /bde gsal mi rtog lha mo'i thugs la bstod/ /ma gcig lha mo'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /mthu ldan las kyi pho nya drag shul can/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong la rab brtson pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de ltar mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas nas/ /dam la gnas pa'i dam can khyed rnams kyis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/

/tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /yid la re ba'i don de 'bad med du/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur du 'grub bar mdzod/ /gtad do gnyer ro dmag zor re ma tī/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel myur ba'i las la bskul/ /bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub bar mdzod/ /bhyoḥ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog rnams dang / /dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs dang / /phyi nang mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang / /rdo rje mched lcam la sogs dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dang slob dpon dmar po sogs/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma la/ /rang snang ma dag log lta ci bgyis pa/ /bsam pa dag pa'i snying nas mthol lo bshags/ /phyi nang rgyud sder gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /tshul bzhin bsrung zhing bsgrub pa dam bcas kyang / /bdag cag las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /lus ngag yid kyi nongs par mthol lo bshags/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur rab nos nas/ /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag dam tshig nyams/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bsam pa dag pas snying nas mthol lo bshags/ /rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam la sogs pa/ /log lta ngan sems rku 'phrog brdeg la sogs/ /ngan smras gnod sems dngos shugs gang bgyis pa/ /sku yi dam tshig༞ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen bsgrub g.yel gyur te/ /phyag rgya rnam bzhi gzhung bzhin ma grub cing / /bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod 'bad rtsol ma bgyis pa/ /gsung gi dam tshig༞ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /snod min rnams la gsang ba mi sbed pa/ /tshig tu smras shing tshul bzhin ma bsgrub pa/ /thugs kyi dam tshig༞ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas tshogs gyur kyang / /dmag zor lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /yid ches mos gus rtse gcig 'bral med kyis/ /bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin ma 'grub༞ /mi shes gti mug 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ /dmag zor lha mo 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/

/sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa/ /lha mo 'khor dang bcas la༞ /ye shes lha mo thugs rje'i spyan ldan des/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /g.yel ba med par thugs rjes bskyabs gyur kyang / /gtang rag dus su ma 'grub༞ /bdag cag khyod la ma dad ma lags mod/ /mi shes dbang gis dam tshig nyams pa dang / /dam nyams zas kyis log par mchod la sogs/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la mthol lo bshags/ /g.yo sgyu zol zog med pa'i sgo gsum gyis/ /mthol bshags phul bas nyams chags dag nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /mchog dang thun mong bkra shis ma lus stsol/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ mdos glud rnams kyi 'bag pa dang / mi gtsang ba sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tha khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ mdos rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs zhing rgya che ba zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po rgyun mi chad par gyur cig oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos glud rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad mgron so so'i yid bzhin du thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur cig oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a dya nutpanna twa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mdos mgron so so'i gang la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ke te na maḥs manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hrī da dzwa la ya swāhā/ mdos mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med pa so so'i yid bzhin du tshims zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig na maḥs manta buddha naṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya hā na hūm̐ phaṭa/

mdos rdzas rnams bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar zad pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig bhyoḥ bcom dung bcom rol bsangs bzhin la shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs rol/ ma ni dges chen rtag pa'i mkha'/ ma mo'i 'bru bshad/ /mo ni bde chen longs spyod klong / /ma ni rtag chen g.yu 'brug mkha'/ /mo ni chags med byang chub klong / /ma ni sku gsung thugs kyi mkha'/ /mo ni lus ngag yid gsum klong / /ma ni rgyal ba kun gyi mkha'/ mo ni srid pa kun gyi klong / /ma ni skye ba med pa'i mkha'/ /mo ni 'gag pa med pa'i klong / /ma ni thabs mchog 'dod yon mkha'/ /mo ni shes rab chags med klong / /ma ni nam mkha' nyid kyi mkha'/ /mo ni sems kyi sems nyid klong / /ma ni chos kyi dbyings nyid mkha'/ /mo ni bha ga nyid kyi dbyings/ /ma ni kun gzhi bde chen mkha'/ /mo ni rnam shes hūm̐ chen 'bar/ /mkha' klong gnyis su dag bsgom zhing / /thig le chen por blo brtan pas/ /lus la ma mo dbang du bsdus/ /dbang du bsdus la zil gyis gnon/ /zhes brjod la rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas/ hūm̐ nga ni dbang phyug chen po ste/ shlau ka gcig la nga rgyal bskyed pa'i dbyangs rol tshar gnyis skye med ma dang 'dra/ nga ni khrag 'thung kun gyi bdag /khams gsum snying gi dwangs ma'i bdag /nga ni khro rgyal kī la ya/ shur ma/ /nga ni khams gsum srid gsum bdag /nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi gtso/ /khams gsum srid gsum nga yi dbang / /'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson/ /nga ni srid gsum kun gyi rgyal/ /nga ni khro bo kun gyi brjid/ /nga ni khro mo kun gyi bdag /nga ni ma mo kun gyi rje/ /nga ni dbang phyug kun gyi dpon/ /yon bdag skyabs gnas mgon bgyid do/ /tshig rol lan gsum/ shur/ hūm̐ khams gsum sha yis nga mi 'grangs/ /'gram chen g.yas pa mdung ltar rno/

/khams gsum khrag gis nga mi ngoms/ /'gram chen g.yon pa zhags ltar 'khyil/ /ha ha zhes ni bza' bar byed/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes ni dbang du sdud/ /dbang du bsdus la zil gyis mnan/ /de ring yon bdag glud chen 'di/ /de ring bgegs chen cig la ster/ /de ring btsan la than cig gtong / /de ring rmu la than cig gtong / /deng 'dir khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /de ring srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /bhyoḥ deng 'dir ma mo'i khram po yi/ /srid pa'i rgyal mo gnas 'dir mchis/ /nad kyi bdag mo gnas༞ /rims kyi bdag mo༞ /de ring srid pa'i dal kha gcod/ /de ring srid pa'i rims kha sgyur/ /de ring bdud kyi bdud kha sgyur/ /de ring btsan gyi zor kha sgyur/ /bzlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bhyoḥ gzhan yang ma'i dbyangs rol/ ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo ni/ /'od srung bstan pa nub ka ru/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / /smon lam gcig tu btab pa'i mthus/ /shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson/ /sku ni kun tu bzang mo ma/ /gsung ni sgra dbyangs brjod las 'das/ /thugs ni spros med rtsis las 'das/ /che mchog 'bar ba'i sku gsum la/ dgongs pa'i mkha' la phyed tsam nub/ /'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson/ /yab yum gnyis med 'phro 'du las/ /'byung ba'i ma mo thams cad bskyed/ /snang srid ma mo 'byung zhing spro/ /nad kyi rkyal pa sbyor zhing gtong / /skye 'chi rtsad gcod thugs su chud/ 'dir klong / /'byung ba kun gyi cha snyoms la/ /thig le'i dbyings las bskyed pa'i yum/ /thugs sprul bskyed cing ma tshogs sdud/ dam la/ /ma mo bha ga kun sdud ma/ ra grags pa'i/ /bkrag dang mdangs dang dbugs kyi bdag /kun gyi yum chen 'dir gshegs la/ /mdos glud srid pa'i rgyal mos bzhes/ /mdos bdag chen mo mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig tshig rol/

/rdzas bdag chen mo rdzas bzhes shig /ces brjod ngar mi la dpal 'bar gsum spar la glud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ glud mchog ngar gyi mi bo che/ yang dag don du'i dbyangs rol/ /rgyu ni rin chen brgyad las grub/ rnam pa/ /zho sha'i snying la lung thang mig /'gron bu'i so la mu tig klad/ /zer mo'i sgro la 'phan bzang skra/ /rkang pa g.yas pa thabs chen lcags/ /rkang g.yon shes rab zangs las byas/ /rnam shes lnga la 'bru sna lnga/ /sku gsung thugs la mar me gsum/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /'bras bu sku gsung thugs dang ldan/ /rten 'brel rnam shes lnga dang ldan/ /skye mched bcu gnyis 'di la tshang / mu bzhi/ /khams chen bco brgyad 'di la༞ /yon tan thams cad 'di la༞ /lag pa g.yas su gser bskur ste/ 'di nas shur ma dus babs la tshig rol/ /gser 'od dag rgyu lam se lam/ /lag pa g.yon du g.yu bskur te/ /g.yu 'od dag du khro lo lo/ /yon bdag lus las gos phud te/ /gos de ngar gyi lus la bkon/ /gos bzang po zhig lhubs se lhubs/ /yon bdag ske nas brgyan bkrol te/ /rgyan de ngar gyi ske ru btags/ /brgyan bzang ba cig bkrag dang ldan/ /smra mkhas pa cig ngag re 'jam/ /tshangs pa yi ni gsung dang ldan/ /gsung snyan pa cig kyu ru ru/ /'gro mkhas pa cig khyung chen 'gros/ /khyung 'gros bzhin du ldeg se ldeg /mi yi glud du nga bzang zer/ /kha nas su 'dod nga longs zer/ /mi bas glud bzang ya la la/ /rdzas bas khab 'gro khyi li li/ /glud 'di srid pa'i rgyal mos bzhes/ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bdag cag rnal 'byor yon mched kyi/ /glud mchog dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /nad kha chod la dal kha sgyur/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /bzlog byed ma yi dus la babs/ /sgyur byed ma yi dus la༞ /zhes brjod mdos bsngo ni 'di skad do/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ 'di man thams cad rnga 'phar brdung yin/ sna tshogs 'bru dang rin chen las/

/byas pa'i ri rab chen po la/ /dpag bsam gyi ni shing bu dang / /sna tshogs rin chen nam mkha' dang / /mthing nag nam mkha' bkrag dang ldan/ /ci 'dod zas dang nor gyis brgyan/ /ye shes thugs kyi rang bzhin der/ /rnam shes dwang ma mdangs kyi glud/ mdos bdag chen mo༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bdud mda' de ni mthing nag la/ /g.yas shun nag po gung dngos nas/ /mda' nag gis ni stong la brgyan/ /pho bdud rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi/ gnas su 'bul lo dkor du bsngo/ /skyes pa pho yi glud du 'bul/ /mthun pa yi ni glud bzhes shig /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /sna tshogs 'bru dang rin chen las/ /byas pa'i zas mchog 'brang rgyas la/ /ci 'dod nor dang zas kyis brgyan/ /ri bo chen po dang mnyam dang / /g.yu yi de ni mo 'phang la/ /gser gyi de ni me long gsal/ /sna tshogs tshon dang rgyan gyis brgyan/ /ma bdud rgyal mo 'khor bcas la/ /gnas su 'bul lo dkor du bsngo/ /za ma mo yi glud du 'bul/ /mthun pa yi ni glud bzhes shig /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /sna tshogs 'bru dang rin chen las/ /byas pa'i mkha' 'gro nam mkha' lding / /gzugs bzang dbyibs legs yid du 'ong / /mdangs bzang spu mdog bkrag dang ldan/ /spu sdug 'od ni lam se lam/ /'gro mkhas pa cig ldeg se ldeg /'phur mkhas pa cig ling se ling / tshig rol/ /spyan bkrag pa cig hrig se hrig /gsung snyan pa cig kyu ru ru/ /lus la mthing nag dar gyis brgyan/ /dar nag cod paṇa pu ru ru/ /ma mo mkha' lding rlung bzhes shig /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /kyai bhyoḥ gzhan yang glud mchog dam pa ni/ /maṃ sa sha yi phung po dang / /spos chen dri yi bdug spos dang / /gzugs mdzes me tog sna tshogs dang / /bza' dang bca' dang btung ba bgo /spyan gzigs sna tshogs dkor char ldan/ /dri bzang sman sna sna tshogs dang / /la zas lung zas sna tshogs dang /

/'bru sna sna tshogs rin chen nor/ /stag gzig gos dar sna tshogs dang / /mi yi longs spyod sna tshogs dang / /gnam la 'phur dgu sna tshogs dang / /sa la 'gro ba sna tshogs dang / /chu la 'dzul ba sna tshogs dang / /lus kyi lhu chen bcu gnyis dang / /mgo bo dang ni bcu gsum ste/ glud bshams/ /'dod yon lnga ru byin brlabs nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dang srog gi glud du 'bul/ /mi yi glud du 'di dga' 'o/ /rdzas pas de ni khab dro'o/ /mthun pa yi ni glud bzhes shig /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bsgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du bsgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la bsgyur/ /byol kha thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams dgra la bsgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /tshig rol/ mdos dang glud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma'i dus/ /gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos dar te/ /gsang sngags grong bsnyen dar ba dang / bon ltar gyer ba/ /dge sdig 'chol pa spyad pa'i tshe/ /de dus srid pa'i rgyal mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan nas/ khyed kyi/ kha rlangs nag po btang ba yi/ /mkha' la nad sprin nag po chags/ /bud med nag mos 'dzam gling bkang / /de tshe nad kyi rkyal pa phye/ /lhog pa dkar nag 'brum nag dang / /rims nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /skran dang dmu chu'i nad rnams dang / /bas ldag g.yen pa de nas 'byung / /nad rkyal ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /khrag kyang ma mo khyod kyi khrag /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad kha chod la dal kha bsgyur/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /bzlog byed ma yi dus la bab/ /sgyur byed ma yi dus la babs/ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /nad kyang༞

/zhes pa nas bzlog bsgyur zhes pa'i bar kun la 'gre'o/ bhyoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma'i dus/ /gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos dar ste/ /gsang sngags grong bsnyen dar ba dang / bon ltar gyer ba/ /dge sdig 'chol bar spyad pa'i tshe/ /de dus srid pa'i rgyal mo khros/ /ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan nas/ /ri rab shar gyi 'dzam gling du/ khyed kyi/ kha rlangs dkar po btang ba yis/ /mkha' la nad sprin dkar po chags/ /bud med dkar mos 'dzam gling bkang / /de tshe nad kyi rkyal pa phye/ nad kyi rigs/ /mdze nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /shu ba dang ni 'brum bu dang / /glo gzer dang ni skya sbab dang / /rlung nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /yams nad rims nad de nas byung / /nad kyang༞ /khrag kyang༞ /rims kyang༞ /bdag cag༞ /nad kha༞ /ltas ngan༞ /zlog byed༞ /sgyur byed༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ bhyoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi༞ /gsang sngags 'bras bu'i༞ /gsang sngags grong bsnyen༞ /dge sdig༞ /de dus srid pa'i༞ /ma mo khros༞ /ri rab lho yi༞ /longs spyod kyi/ kha rlangs ser po༞ /mkha' la nad sprin ser po༞ /bud med ser mo༞ /de tshe nad kyi༞ /nad kyi rigs/ nad chen mkhris pa sha ya dang / /sha ser mig ser nad rnams dang / /rgya nad mig ser de nas byung / /nad kyang༞ /khrag kyang༞ /rims kyang༞ /bdag cag༞ /nad kha༞ /ltas ngan༞ /bzlog byed༞ /sgyur byed༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ bhyoḥ lnga brgya dus༞ /gsang sngags 'bras bu'i༞ /gsang sngags grong bsnyen༞ /dge sdig༞ /de dus༞ /ma mo khros༞ /ri rab nub༞ /kha rlangs dmar po༞ /mkha' la nad sprin dmar po༞ /bud med dmar mos༞ /de tshe nad kyi༞ /nad ni khrag nad gzer 'thab dang / /khrag tu skyug dang 'khru ba dang / /bal nad rgyu gzer de nas byung / /nad kyang༞ /khrag kyang༞ /rims kyang༞ /bdag cag༞ /nad kha༞ /ltas ngan༞ /bzlog byed༞

/sgyur byed༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ bhyoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi༞ /gsang sngags 'bras bu'i༞ /gsang sngags grong bsnyen༞ /dge sdig༞ /de dus srid pa'i༞ /ma mo༞ /ri rab byang gi༞ /kha rlangs sngon po༞ /mkha' la nad sprin sngon po༞ /bud med sngon mos༞ /de tshe nad kyi༞ /mi nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /phyugs nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /yams nad rims nad sna tshogs dang / /glo brdol smyo 'bog de nas byung / /nad kyang༞ /khrag kyang༞ /rims kyang༞ /bdag cag nad kha༞ /ltas ngan༞ /zlog byed༞ /sgyur byed༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /re ma tī cho 'brang dang bstun nas glud bsngo ba ni 'di skad do/ /bhyoḥ tshig rkang rgyab ma la sho thugs ma'i dbyangs rol mo/ dpal ldan gnyen gyi re ma tī/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dpa' mo btsan/ /de yang byang shar re ma tī/ /mdos bdag chen mo mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen mo glud bzhes shig /rdzas bdag chen mo rdzas bzhes shig /de yang byang shar zhes pa nas rdzas bdag chen mo zhes pa'i bar 'gre'o/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyen gyi re ma tī/ /'bar ba me khyer glog phreng 'dzin/ /de yang byang shar༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyen gyi re ma tī/ /rgya mtsho'i steng na bzhugs tsa na/ /na bza' bra gyon ral gcig ma/ /klu srin sde brgyad dbang sdud ma/ /'gro ba kun gyi tshe 'dzin ma/ /de yang byang shar༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ bhyoḥ dpal ldan dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi/ /gtso mo chen mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /ming sring g.yag mgo thod rlon 'chang / /de yang byang shar༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bhyoḥ dpal ldan༞ /ma brgyad gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /e ka dza ṭī ral gcig ma/ /rnal 'byor tshe 'dzin drod nyul ma/ de yang༞ /mdos bdag༞ /glud bdag༞ /rdzas bdag༞ /bhyoḥ /dpal ldan༞

/ma bud gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje shanti kun grags ma/ /bshugs pa kun gyi bka' nyan ma/ /'dre srin 'bum sde dmyal thag gcod/ /de yang༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /bhyoḥ dpal ldan༞ /sring bzhi'i gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha ma srin/ /nyi ma'i zer la zhon byed ma/ /'phung byed gnam the dmyal thag gcod/ /de yang༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /bhyoḥ dpal ldan༞ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /lha mo khyod kyi lto ba la/ /lha rnams kun gyis rdzong bcas nas/ /lha min rnams kyi g.yul bzlog ma/ /de yang༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /bhyoḥ dpal ldan༞ /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma ni/ /bcu gnyis gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sman btsun ug chos g.yar mo bsil/ /phyi 'khor skyong zhing 'dre srin 'dul/ /de yang༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /kyai bhyoḥ tshig rol dang yang shur ma/ re ti mgo g.yag man chad nas/ /'ching ba zhags thog thams cad dang / /bdud rigs gtogs pa thams cad kyis/ /bskor gyin bskor gyin phyag byas kyang / /lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag len mi ster khros tshul ston/ /mdos glud lha mo khyod bzhes la/ /bdud kyi lag nas mi bla khug /kyai bhyoḥ skyes bu klu btsan man chad nas/ /chun po skyogs ka yan chad kyis/ /bskor gyin bskor gyin phyag byas kyang / /lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs/ /phyag len mi ster khros tshul ston/ /mdos glud lha mo khyod bzhes la/ /btsan gyi lag nas mi bla khug /gnam lha dkar po man chad nas/ /rgyal 'gong the rang yan chad kyis/ /bskor gyin༞ /sogs 'gre'o/ /lha mos de la༞ /phyag len༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rgyal po'i lag nas༞ /bhyoḥ srid pa'i rgyal mo man chad nas/ /nag mo grong rgyu yan chad kyis/ /bskor gyin༞ /lha mos de la༞ /phyag len༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /ma mo'i lag nas༞ /bhyoḥ ma bdud rgyal mo man chad nas/ /dur khrod 'dre mo yan chad kyis/ /bskor gyin༞

/lha mos de la༞ /phyag len༞ /mdos༞ /glud bdag༞ /nad bdag lag nas༞ /bdag la ltos pa'i yon bdag la/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /dus la babs nas tshe zad kyang / /lo gsum da dung shol thob la/ /tshe sring bar chad med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor nga yi bka' ma bcag /yon bdag drin lan chud ma gsan/ /tshig rol yang shur ma/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ seng chen dkar po man chad nas/ /sder chags byi ba yan chad kyis/ /gcan gzan chig khri nyis stong gis/ /dpal chen mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /mkha' lding gser mig man chad nas/ /gshog thog chig khri nyis stong gis/ /dpal chen mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /dpal ldan lha mos thugs dam bskang / /phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /nang gi mchod pas༞ /dza gad phud kyis༞ /ma hā raktas༞ /ba ling gtor mas༞ /longs spyod tshogs kyis༞ /khrag chen arghaṃ༞ /dbang po lnga yis༞ /tshil chen dud pas༞ /zhun chen mar mes༞ /khrag zhag mkhris chen dri yis bskang / /sha rus zhal zas dag gis༞ /rkang gling gdangs gcig 'bud/ thod rnga rkang gling sgra yis༞ /g.yab dar nag po dag gis༞ /gos dar sna tshogs dag gis༞ /go khrab stag gzig rnams kyis༞ /zang zing mdos chen dag gis༞ /nam mkha' nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan lha mos thugs dam bskang / /re ma tī yi thugs dam bskang / 'dis 'gres so/ /'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang / /gshin rje'i lcam gcig༞ /bdud kyi yum gcig༞ /ma mo chen mo'i༞ /dbang phyug chen mo'i༞ /gar gyi dbang phyug༞ /lha mo nag mo'i༞ /dus bzhi lha mos༞ /rnal 'byor srung ma'i༞ /ma gcig lha mo'i༞ /rgyang bu nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i༞ /re ma tī yi༞ /'dod khams dbang phyug༞ /gshin rje'i bdud kyi༞ /ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar gyi༞ /lha mo༞ /dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /bdud phrug nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī༞ /'dod khams dbang phyug༞

/gshin rje lcam gcig༞ /bdud kyi yum gcig thugs dam bskang / /ma mo chen mo'i༞ /dbang phyug chen mo'i༞ /gar gyi dbang phyug thugs dam bskang / /lha mo nag mo'i༞ /dus bzhi lha mo'i༞ /rnal 'byor srung ma'i༞ /ma gcig lha mo'i༞ /bshos bu nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī༞ /'dod khams dbang phyug༞ /gshin rje'i༞ /bdud kyi༞ /ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar༞ /lha mo༞ /dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /mda' nag stong dmar bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī yi༞ /'dod khams༞ /gshin rje'i༞ /bdud kyi༞ /ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar gyi༞ /lha mo༞ dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /lpags nag gung sram bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī yi༞ /'dod khams༞ /gshin rje'i༞ /bdud kyi༞ /ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar gyi༞ /lha mo༞ /dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /'brang rgyas nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī yi༞ /'dod khams༞ /gshin rje'i༞ /bdud kyi༞ ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar gyi༞ /lha mo༞ /dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /mda' 'phang nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī yi༞ /'dod khams༞ /gshin rje'i༞ /bdud kyi༞ /ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar gyi༞ /lha mo༞ /dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /bya nag shol mig bcu gsum gyis/ /dpal ldan༞ /re ma tī yi༞ /'dod khams༞ /gshin rje'i༞ /bdud kyi༞ /ma mo༞ /dbang phyug༞ /gar gyi༞ /lha mo༞ /dus bzhi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /ma gcig༞ /khyed kyi thugs dam bskang gyur cig /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig /dam tshig nyams chags bskang gyur cig /hūm̐ bhyoḥ tshig rol dpal chen nas mi mthun thams cad la tshig rol/ dpal chen mgon po nag po dang / /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo khyed/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi dur khrod du/ /'khor du dri za 'bum gyis bskor/ /longs spyod sha dang khrag la rol/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung /

/dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs/ /gtor mdos len pa'i dus la babs/ /mdos glud blang ba'i dus la babs/ /rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i dus la babs/ /bzlog bsgyur chen po'i dus la babs/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /mdos bdag chen mo mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen mo༞ /rdzas bdag chen mo rdzas bzhes shig /mdos glud bzhes la gzung ba thongs/ /bcings pa khrol la mnan pa theg /yo ba srongs la bub pa slongs/ /bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs/ /tshig rol dgu brdung / mi mthun rkyen ngan dgra la bsgyur/ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal chen mgon po nag po dang / /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo khyed/ /lho yi phyogs kyi dur khrod du/ zhes 'gre'o/ 'khor du gru bum༞ /longs spyod༞ /las su༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /gtor༞ /mdos glud༞ /rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i༞ /bka'༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /mdos glud༞ /bcings༞ /yo ba༞ /bde legs༞ /mi mthun༞ /tshig rol dgu rdung / hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal chen mgon po nag po dang / /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo khyod/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi dur khrod du/ /'khor du chu lha༞ /longs spyod༞ /las su༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /gtor༞ /mdos glud༞ /rkyenangan༞ /bzlog༞ /bka'༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /mdos༞ /bcings༞ /yo ba༞ /bde legs༞ /mi mthun༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal chen mgon po nag po dang / /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo khyod/ /byang gi phyogs gyi dur khrod du/ /'khor du gnod sbyin༞ /longs spyod༞ /las su༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /gtor༞ /mdos glud༞ /rkyen༞ /bzlog༞ /bka'༞ /mdos༞ /glud༞ /rdzas༞ /mdos glud༞ /bcings༞ /yo ba༞ /bde legs༞ /mi mthun༞ /zhes pa la sogs pa brjod do/ tshig rol dgu brdung chem brdung gsum brdeg len can/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ ma dbyangs dang bu dbyangs can/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod khams mkha' 'gro gtso mo mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /nam gru khyod kyi cho 'brang dang /

/mtshan nyid dang ni bshad bya ba/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin khyod kyi lus/ /rgyab ni 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser/ /khyod kyi gdong yang dngul yin te/ /lto ba'i ngos ni rdo rjes gtams/ /ming po mdzod dang mdzod srung ba/ /khyod kyi ma ni kun 'gro ma/ /khyod kyi pha ni rlung zhes bya/ /skal ldan shing rta khyod kyi rus/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ba'i tshal/ /yongs 'du'i shing la nyer bstan cing / /'jig rten gsum gyi dge legs kun/ /nyer bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /'dzam bu gling gi shar lho'i mtshams/ /de wī ko ḍar gnas bcas shing / /bha trā'i shing la rab bsten ma/ /zhing skyong gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /gang gis khyod kyis mtshan 'dzin pa/ /de la lha klu mi rnams kyi/ /rims nad gnod pa zhi mdzad cing / /dgra bgegs tshar gcod khyod la bstod/ /shin tu gus pa'i yid ldan pas/ /nam gru rgyas pa 'di brjod na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig gcig la rol mo blangs la dgu brdung gnyis/ 12 bhyoḥ dmag zor rgyal mo mthu rtsal can/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma dang / /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /'gro ba'i don rnams sgrub pa dang / /snying nas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la/ /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog /'byung po'i thod zor 'phen pa bzlog /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog /ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa bzlog /bon po'i gtad zor 'phen pa bzlog /ban de'i sngags zor 'phen pa bzlog /skyes pa'i mda' zor༞ /bud med dmod zor༞ /mu stegs bar chad byed pa༞ /ngan sngags gdug pa'i rbod gtong༞ /klu yi byad du bcug pa༞ /the'u rang sri la rku ba༞ /rgyal po'i smyo 'bogs btang ba༞

/drang srong gza' yi gnod pa༞ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi༞ /ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu༞ /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad༞ /mtshan ma ngan pa༞ /lo keg zla keg zhag keg༞ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi༞ /mkha' 'gro'i bar chad byed pa༞ /ro langs bar chad byed pa༞ /rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa༞ /yas kyi bdud g.yos thams cad༞ /mas kyi sri langs thams cad༞ /pha tshan rgyab 'dre༞ /ma mo'i byol kha༞ /mo ngan mthu rigs༞ /ltas ngan rigs gyur༞ /'bangs kyi bsam ngan༞ /chos kyi chos zor༞ /bon gyi bon zor༞ /sde brgyad smyo 'bog༞ /nyung zor 'phen pa༞ /khrag zor 'phen pa༞ /zhang zhung gtso zor 'phen༞ /sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa༞ /mi nag gto nag༞ /mi kha dug mchu thams cad bzlog /ltas ngan thams cad dgra la sgyur/ /bdud kyi sgo gro dgra la sgyur/ /btsan gyi zhags 'debs dgra la sgyur/ /ma mo'i dal yams dgra la sgyur/ /khram kha babs pa dgra la sgyur/ /sho rde babs pa dgra la sgyur/ /de la sogs pa'i sdang sems rnams/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig la bhyo/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad la bhyo/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo/ /bcol lo gtad do re ma tī/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /dgu brdung chems brdungs drag dung rdzogs dung ma til/ bhyoḥ spyi btab sogs dang / dpal ldan dmag zor 'di rang gi dbyangs can rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud phrug bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas/ /chos dbyings dbang phyug ma gcig bdud kyi yum/ /drag mo nam gru tshim byed mnga' bdag mo/ /srog bdag ma mo dpal gyi rdo rje lcam/ /sde brgyad bdag mo dpal ldan gshin rje'i yum/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /bka' bstod pho nya bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud dang srin mo gshin rje'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dur khrod bdag mo zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/
